# Fixture Logs

Minimal integration package used to self-test the reusable CI and release
workflows in
[elastic-package-workflows](https://github.com/NateShoffner/elastic-package-workflows).
It is not useful for collecting real data.

## Data streams

The `sample` data stream reads lines shaped like
`2026-01-02T03:04:05.000Z INFO fixture started` from a file and parses them into
`level` and `detail`.

## Setup

For more details about the Filestream input settings, check the [Filebeat documentation](https://www.elastic.co/docs/reference/beats/filebeat/filebeat-input-filestream).


### Collecting logs from Filestream

To collect logs via Filestream, select **Collect logs via Filestream** and configure the following parameters:

- Filestream paths: The full path to the related log file.
